text:
mira: quick follow-up from the weights-format RFC. ran into a shard that had a subtle header mismatch and produced NaNs during a GEMM. thinking a tiny header-probe on open + background full-verify. quick thumbs?

jon: can you paste the node log (minimal)?

mira: gist:
```
[2026-09-02T08:12:03Z] load_shard ckpt-21-p3.safetensors: index ok, header=unknown
[2026-09-02T08:12:03Z] WARN loader: dtype mismatch expected=float16 found=quant8
RuntimeError: GEMM produced NaN
```

sasha: two tradeoffs: eager header probe (small parse, early failure) vs lazy exec-verify (fail later). eager seems better for developer predictability.

dmitri: agree for Hosted/Dedicated. Private deployments should be configurable. ops: any operational concerns?

ops: main risk is rollout causing many reopens to fail. add a canary toggle and metrics `weights.header_mismatch.rate` and `weights.open.latency`. Also a kill switch.

mira: proposal: header fields = magic, serializer_id, schema_version, epoch, mini_sig, optional full_checksum_url. WeightSource.open() returns metadata map with optional strings `serializer_id` and `probe_status` values: "unknown"|"header_ok"|"header_mismatch"|"deep_ok"|"deep_corrupt". Backwards compatible.

jon: keep probe cheap (parse first N bytes). runtime: on header_mismatch -> try fallback variant and emit `weights.fallback.attempt`; if fallback fails surface error.

ci-bot: adding `serializer-roundtrip` job to eng-ml CI: write shard -> header probe -> compute full checksum -> assert deep_ok. Hook on serializer PRs.

sasha: Console: add per-checkpoint integrity badge: green/amber/red. For live flips to red, auto-ticket for Dedicated/Private.

mira: rollout sketch: sample probe 2% -> enable for new uploads, legacy accepted but flagged `legacy` and queued for background verify -> tenant toggle to block legacy after X days. owners: mira (author), jon (loader), sasha (console), ops (rollout). filing RFC patch now.

jon: SGTM

dmitri: SGTM

ops: SGTM, coordinate canary windows with infra calendar.

mira: thanks all, tagging @team-eng-ml :eyes:
